name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-commerce-gift
description: Cadeau: create a gift, receiver shop, admin offers. Disable to hide the Offer menu and gift APIs.

receiverTokenTtlDays.label: Receiver token TTL (days)
receiverTokenTtlDays.description: Days a receiver link stays valid before the giver must send a new one.
receiverTokenTtlDays.sectionDescription: How long tokens, holds, and pay windows last.

extendCeilingDays.label: Extend ceiling (days)
extendCeilingDays.description: Furthest a giver may extend a promise. Raise only if you allow longer gifts.

lockSessionTtlHours.label: Lock session TTL (hours)
lockSessionTtlHours.description: Hours a receiver PIN session stays unlocked on that browser.

stockHoldTtlDays.label: Stock hold TTL (days)
stockHoldTtlDays.description: Days reserved stock is held after the receiver picks, until the giver pays.

giverPayTtlDays.label: Giver pay TTL (days)
giverPayTtlDays.description: Days the giver has to pay after the receiver chose. After that the hold is released.

visibilityAfterTerminalDays.label: Visibility after terminal (days)
visibilityAfterTerminalDays.description: Days a finished gift stays visible in history before it is hidden.

purgeAfterDays.label: Purge after (days)
purgeAfterDays.description: Days after terminal before cron deletes leftover gift rows. Keep aligned with legal retention.

selectReminderBefore.label: Select reminder lead time
selectReminderBefore.description: How early the receiver is reminded to pick (for example 3d) before the select window ends.
selectReminderBefore.sectionDescription: Lead times for select / hold / pay reminder mails.

holdReminderBefore.label: Hold reminder lead time
holdReminderBefore.description: How early the giver is reminded a stock hold will expire.

payReminderBefore.label: Pay reminder lead time
payReminderBefore.description: How early the giver is reminded to pay before the pay window ends.

minBudget.label: Minimum budget
minBudget.description: Lowest gift budget the giver may set, in euros.
minBudget.sectionDescription: Money caps and how many PIN guesses a receiver gets.

maxBudgetCeiling.label: Maximum budget ceiling
maxBudgetCeiling.description: Highest gift budget for products, in euros.

maxAccessoryBudgetCeiling.label: Maximum accessory budget ceiling
maxAccessoryBudgetCeiling.description: Highest extra budget for accessories, in euros.

maxOpenPromisesPerGiver.label: Max open promises per giver
maxOpenPromisesPerGiver.description: How many unfinished gifts one giver may have at once.

pinFailures.label: PIN failures (free:max)
pinFailures.description: Free guesses then lock (for example 5:8). Raise only if receivers struggle on mobile.

cronLog.label: Cron log path
cronLog.description: JSONL path for the gift reminder cron. Change only if you relocated kernel logs.
cronLog.sectionDescription: Paths for gift crons. Leave defaults unless logs moved.

cronPurgeLog.label: Purge cron log path
cronPurgeLog.description: JSONL path for the gift purge cron.

rateGiftPin.label: PIN rate limit
rateGiftPin.sectionDescription: Flood caps for PIN, create-email, and share-card. Disable switches are for local tests only.

disableRateGiftPin.label: Disable PIN rate limit
disableRateGiftPin.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.

disableRateGiftCreateEmail.label: Disable create-email rate limit
disableRateGiftCreateEmail.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.

disableRateGiftShareCardUpdate.label: Disable share-card update rate limit
disableRateGiftShareCardUpdate.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.

disableRateGiftShareCardDownload.label: Disable share-card download rate limit
disableRateGiftShareCardDownload.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.

disableRateGiftShareCardEmail.label: Disable share-card email rate limit
disableRateGiftShareCardEmail.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.
